caseNameFull: Betka v. A-T Industries, Inc. Restrepo v. First National Bank of Dona Ana County, New Mexico

opinions.text:
Sup. Ct. Ore.; and

C. A. 5th Cir. Motions of *907petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. See this Court’s Rule 39.8. Petitioners are allowed until March 15, 1993, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33 of the Rules of this Court.

Justice Blackmun and Justice Stevens would deny the petitions for writs of certiorari.
